shortDescription: Manage Bridge Domains (BDs) in schema templates

options.name: arp_flooding
options.description: ARP Flooding

options.name: bd
options.description: The name of the BD to manage.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of BD is supported on versions of MSO that are 3.3 or greater.

options.name: dhcp_policies
options.description: A list DHCP Policies to be assciated with the BD This option can only be used on versions of MSO that are 3.1.1h or greater.

options.name: dhcp_policy
options.description: The DHCP Policy

options.name: display_name
options.description: The name as displayed on the MSO web interface.

options.name: ep_move_detection_mode
options.description: Enables detection of endpoint moves using Gratuitous ARP (GARP) packets.

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the ACI Multi Site Orchestrator host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: intersite_bum_traffic
options.description: Whether to allow intersite BUM traffic.

options.name: ipv6_unknown_multicast_flooding
options.description: IPv6 Unknown Multicast Flooding can either be Flood or Optimized Flooding

options.name: layer2_stretch
options.description: Whether to enable L2 stretch.

options.name: layer2_unknown_unicast
options.description: Layer2 unknown unicast.

options.name: layer3_multicast
options.description: Whether to enable L3 multicast.

options.name: login_domain
options.description: The login domain name to use for authentication. The default value is Local. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_LOGIN_DOMAIN) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_login_domain) will be used if this attribute is not specified.

options.name: multi_destination_flooding
options.description: Multi-Destination Flooding can either be Flood in BD, Drop or Flood in Encapsulation. Flood in Encapsulation is only supported on versions of MSO that are 3.3 or greater.

options.name: multicast_route_map_destination_filter
options.description: The name of the Route Map Destination Filter. The Route Map Destination Filter must reside in the same tenant as the tenant associated to the schema. This option can only be used when the BD has Layer 3 Multicast enabled. Providing an empty string O(multicast_route_map_destination_filter="") will remove the Route Map Destination Filter from the BD.

options.name: multicast_route_map_source_filter
options.description: The name of the Route Map Source Filter. The Route Map Source Filter must reside in the same tenant as the tenant associated to the schema. This option can only be used when the BD has Layer 3 Multicast enabled. Providing an empty string O(multicast_route_map_source_filter="") will remove the Route Map Source Filter from the BD.

options.name: optimize_wan_bandwidth
options.description: Whether to optimize WAN bandwidth.

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this MSO module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for the REST connection. The default value depends on parameter `use_ssl`. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: schema
options.description: The name of the schema.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing. Use C(query) for listing an object or multiple objects.

options.name: subnets
options.description: The subnets associated to this BD.

options.name: template
options.description: The name of the template. Display Name of template for operations can only be used in some versions of mso. Use the name of template instead of Display Name to avoid discrepency.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. The default value is 30 seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_TIMEOUT) will be used instead.

options.name: unicast_routing
options.description: Unicast Routing This option can only be used on versions of MSO that are 3.1.1h or greater.

options.name: unknown_multicast_flooding
options.description: Unknown Multicast Flooding can either be Flood or Optimized Flooding.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_PROXY) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(false), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_SSL) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_use_ssl) will be used if this attribute is not specified. The default is C(false) when using a HTTPAPI connection plugin (mso or nd) and C(true) when using the legacy connection method (only for mso).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: virtual_mac_address
options.description: Virtual MAC Address

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF associated to this BD. This is required only when creating a new BD.
